purpose: Freeze dates and baseline before broader data collection; no live eligibility.
excluded_from_fresh_evaluation: August 2026: hourly/four-hour data already accessed as smoke warmup; contextual/development only.
limitations: Rates/tick reflect current evidence, not verified historical conditions.
Development lasts 61 days; not proof of coverage across market regimes.
One-minute open proxy cannot verify actionable quote within 60 seconds.
Incomplete-fill and latency scenarios are not implemented; must be specified and tested using development data before validation outcomes are read.
Prospective holdout is future data: do not download or evaluate before completion.
evaluation_policy: Download and inspect schema, completeness and cross-timeframe OHLC only at collection stage; do not inspect validation signals or returns.
Preserve every experiment. A changed strategy receives a new version and explicit hashes.
Freeze all execution scenarios and analysis code before opening validation outcomes.
One independent 100 USDT account per period with 800-hour warmup, no trades from warmup; boundary liquidations identified, periods never compounded as one continuous account.
Same period/cost benchmarks: USDT cash and full-capital buy-and-hold with exposure caveat.
Report all signals, reasons for skips, completed vs boundary trades, net PnL/R, costs, drawdown, loss streaks, exposure, and largest-winner concentration.
For adequate samples, predeclare seeded chronological block-resampling uncertainty on development before validation. Sparse/no trades => inconclusive; no win-rate/count promotion rule.
Nonpositive net expectancy under baseline or stressed costs is adverse evidence; positive results alone do not establish an edge.
No live promotion without execution verification, uncertainty review and forward paper evidence.
